prompt:
Generate a photorealistic 10-second vertical 9:16 image-to-video shot. Shot 1 of a brisk product showcase, not slow motion. Remain in the reference factory assembly aisle, walking past its existing fixtures.
ACTION TIMING: 0.0-0.3s start walking immediately; 0.3-4.5s walk four purposeful normal steps forward as camera tracks backward; 4.5-9.7s continue along the aisle with clear moving background parallax, 9.7-10s keep walking. Action must be clearly visible from the first 0.3 seconds. Real walking and real scene parallax, not a digital zoom on a still image.
IDENTITY: Use ONLY this supplied image for the foreground: preserve the exact mint-green oral irrigator, transparent reservoir, four spare tips, black USB cable, brown fabric pouch, all exact labels and their original capacity numbers; preserve the clear acrylic case, handle material, hinges, rigid geometry, component positions, original printed text and all packaging. Nothing inside moves independently. Keep the original adult woman's single hand with burgundy nails; forearm enters horizontally from frame left, same side throughout. One hand only, five anatomically correct fingers. No face, torso, person reflection or second hand. Background people must remain indistinct and not become presenters.
FRAMING: Box always suspended by its handle, front aimed squarely toward camera. No rotation, orbit, flip, placing down, opening the case or activating the device. Natural small 1-3cm walking bob, wrist compensates. Keep entire handle, box and bottom in frame with margin below and at the sides. Camera may step back early to protect framing. Product remains sharp and central; realistic moving soft background, neutral exposure, no glare obscuring labels.
No additional products, missing accessories, changing letters, new claims, captions, logos, watermark, new props, artificial light flashes, music, speech or sound effects. Never freeze, loop or pad. Preserve foreground appearance over unnecessary movement. Distinct unbranded background area: factory assembly aisle.
